concerns.location: plan.md: Phase 1, Task 1.2 (graph metrics); data-model.md NetworkMetrics
concerns.text: Global efficiency, participation coefficient, and within-network efficiency are undefined for signed (negative-weight) correlation graphs. The plan reconstructs full correlation matrices (values in [-1,1]) and feeds them to NetworkX metrics without specifying edge thresholding, absolute-value weighting, or negative-edge handling. As written, global efficiency with negative weights is not a valid integration measure. Specify the weight transform (e.g., |r| or r>0 with density threshold) before graph metric computation.

With N≈100-200 subjects and up to 20,100 edge-strength predictors, reporting 'top features' from a Ridge model is statistically unstable (p>>n; coefficients shrink non-uniformly and ranking is not identifiable). Either restrict edge-level features to a pre-specified subset, or drop the 'most predictive features' claim and report only cross-validated R² (SC-002).

Power for r=0.20 at alpha=0.05 requires N≈194 for power 0.80; the constitution's N≈100-200 range means the lower half is underpowered. The plan flags power<0.80 per SC-005, which is adequate, but should state that the primary partial-correlation tests are expected to be underpowered at the low end of the N range so a null result is uninformative there.
